payload.description:
## Trigger

When a repository runs the engine and a person sets the prefix with the kit config command, I want both the engine and the kit to mint under that one value, so I can set the prefix once and trust every create.

## Context

Found by the basicly-9pyaygb.4 lane: src/basicly/config.py reads [tracker] prefix from basicly.toml and owned_write.create mints through it, while kit create reads template.json in the ledger.
payload.requirements: One home for the prefix; the other side reads it or refuses by name.
